history.summary: A 646 sqft freehold 1BR in D15 at $1857 PSF / $1.2M, but 1.08km from the nearest MRT and asking ~16% ABOVE the project's $1595 URA median. The flagged ~10.1% CAGR (19 txns) is implausibly high and almost certainly a small-sample artifact.
history.rating_rationale: The asking $1857 PSF is ~16% above the project median of $1595 — a clear overpricing on a 1BR. The headline 10.1% CAGR (19 txns) is statistically dubious and shouldn't be underwritten as forward growth. Poor MRT access (1.08km, 13-min walk) weakens both rental and resale, and $1.2M is a steep quantum for a 1BR. Losing Elo record (144-170). Overpriced + 1BR + far from MRT — Avoid.
red_flags: Asking ~16% above project URA median ($1857 vs $1595)
10.1% CAGR on 19 txns is implausible — small-sample distortion, not a reliable rate
1.08km / 13-min walk to MRT — weak connectivity for a 1BR
$1.2M is a high quantum for a single-bedroom unit
catalysts: Freehold D15 East Coast lifestyle district
